## Definition of Done (DoD) Checklist
*Please verify all items before requesting review:*

- [ ] **Tests:** Unit and integration tests pass locally (`pytest`).
- [ ] **Code Quality:** Linting and formatting pass with `ruff` (`ruff check .` & `ruff format --check .`).
- [ ] **Security & Secrets:** Confirmed no API keys, tokens, database passwords, or credentials are committed.
- [ ] **Data Handling & GxP:** No raw client confidential data or unapproved copyrighted documents included.
- [ ] **Licensing:** Any newly added dependencies use compliant open-source licenses (MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD).
- [ ] **Documentation:** Relevant READMEs, architecture decision records (ADRs), or task board updated.
